answer: I would stop farms with Licensed landfill operator licence with environmental agency confirmation, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. An honest agent spends 14 minutes once; the operator of 454 fakes spends 6356 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Hold the pulse up to the light, weigh the wharf of the attack, and keep the falcon of the verdict where everyone can audit it. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
